Name of the existing managed certificate for the legacy Container App custom domain.
Optional secondary custom domain name to keep bound alongside the primary domain during migrations or cutovers.
Name of the existing managed certificate for the optional secondary custom domain.
Public frontend origin used for canonical URLs, sitemap entries, social cards, and backend CORS. Leave empty to use the default Static Web Apps URL.
Azure region for the Static Web App. Must be a region supported by Azure Static Web Apps.
Optional frontend custom domain to bind to Static Web Apps after its DNS TXT validation record exists.
